mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scrap (user_code, target_type, target_code) VALUES (#{userCode}, #{scrap.targetType}, #{scrap.targetCode}) ON CONFLICT (user_code, target_type, target_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT sc.scrap_code AS scrapCode, s.store_code AS storeCode, s.store_name AS storeName, l.address AS address, s.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, sc.created_at AS createdAt FROM scrap sc JOIN store s ON s.store_code = CAST(sc.target_code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN location l ON l.location_code = s.location_code WHERE sc.user_code = #{userCode} AND sc.target_type = 'STORE' AND s.store_status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC

SELECT sc.scrap_code AS scrapCode, p.post_code AS postCode, p.post_content AS postContent, p.thumbnail AS thumbnail, u.nickname AS nickname, sc.created_at AS createdAt FROM scrap sc JOIN post p ON p.post_code = CAST(sc.target_code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_code = p.user_code WHERE sc.user_code = #{userCode} AND sc.target_type = 'POST' AND p.post_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC
